A beta version of *Fallout 76* , the B.E.T.A. (Break-it Early Test Application), was available to those who pre-ordered the game. [1] [2] 

The beta began on October 23 for Xbox One and on October 30 for PC and PS4. [3] Player progress made during the beta was carried over into the full game. [4] Active periods for the beta were scheduled as followed. [5]
